feed.title: The Shorter Lab: News
feed.subtitle: The Shorter lab focuses on understanding the genetic mechanisms of disease, and the development and use of polygenic risk scores for disease prediction. .

entry.title: John started the Academy of Science Communication (Formidlingsakademiet) at the Royal Danish Academy of Sciences and Letters, a seven-month programme in science writing, public speaking, video and social media.
